title: Multi-output neural network surrogate for double-pulse femtosecond optothermal control of thin silicon films on fused silica
abstract: arXiv:2611.20301v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce a multi-output feedforward neural network surrogate trained on a coupled multiple-reflection and two-temperature model to map double-pulse femtosecond laser excitation (1030 nm) of crystalline silicon films on fused silica across film thicknesses (50-500 nm) and inter-pulse delays (0-10ps). Trained via Levenberg-Marquardt optimization on 2000 physical simulations, the dual-hidden-layer network ([40,30] neurons) simultaneously predicts six strongly coupled optothermal observables, peak electron temperature, peak lattice temperature, peak carrier density, minimum and maximum absorptivity and minimum refractive index achieving coefficients of determination R2 larger than 0.9998 across all targets. Evaluating a dense 200 by 200 design grid in milliseconds resolves pronounced thin-film interference fringes and carrier-induced index modulation, identifying an optimal optothermal coupling regime at d=156 nm and Dt=4.572 ps. translated_title: 熔融石英上硅薄膜双脉冲飞秒光热控制的多输出神经网络代理模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种基于耦合多重反射与双温模型训练的多输出前馈神经网络代理模型，用于映射熔融石英上晶体硅薄膜在双脉冲飞秒激光（1030 nm）激发下的响应，涵盖膜厚范围50-500 nm和脉冲间隔0-10 ps。该双隐层网络（[40,30]个神经元）通过2000次物理模拟并采用Levenberg-Marquardt优化进行训练，可同时预测六个强耦合的光热观测量——峰值电子温度、峰值晶格温度、峰值载流子密度、最小与最大吸收率以及最小折射率，在所有目标上均实现了大于0.9998的决定系数R²。该网络可在毫秒级时间内评估密集的200×200设计网格，清晰解析出显著的薄膜干涉条纹和载流子诱导的折射率调制，并确定了d=156 nm、Δt=4.572 ps处的最优光热耦合区间。
tldr: 提出了一种基于双温物理模型训练的多输出神经网络代理模型，可在毫秒内精确预测双脉冲飞秒激光作用下硅薄膜的六项光热参量，并确定了最优光热耦合参数（膜厚156 nm、脉冲间隔4.572 ps）。
